item.title: Thomas Mann returns to his 'Fatherland' in this practically flawless film
item.description: Fatherland imagines the Nobel Prize-winning author's 1949 return to Germany after years of exile. Just 82 minutes long, this gorgeous film is meticulously staged and shot in black and white.

item.title: New book revisits the 2023 killing of an unhoused man in crisis on the NYC subway
item.description: Jordan Neely was frightening fellow passengers. A former Marine named Daniel Penny put Neely into a chokehold, killing him. Journalist Anand Giridharadas investigates the incident in Man in the Mirror.

item.title: Filmmaking is 'our weapon against intolerance,' say 'La Bola Negra' directors
item.description: Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi have turned four pages of an unfinished play by Federico García Lorca into a sweeping epic that spans 90 years of Spanish history, focusing on the stories of gay men.

item.title: These 'Seven Stories About Tammy' add up to one brilliant piece of writing
item.description: Elizabeth McCracken's connected short stories chronicle a family's encounters with their eldest son's girlfriend and eventual wife. This slim collection is so engaging, you may want to read it twice.
